description: Evidence-based FPS/latency tweaks - no executable code, pure data interpreted by pc-tuner.ps1

tweaks.name: High Performance power plan
tweaks.why: Balanced parks/downclocks cores between frames. One of the few tweaks with consistent measurable benefit. Costs idle watts; trivial on a desktop.

tweaks.name: Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling on
tweaks.why: GPU manages its own memory scheduling - slightly lower input latency, steadier frametimes in DX12/Vulkan. Recommended for RTX 20-series / RX 6000 and newer; skip on older GPUs.

tweaks.name: Game Mode explicitly on
tweaks.why: Deprioritizes background services while a game runs. Main benefit is steadier 1% lows, not raw FPS. No downside.

tweaks.name: Game DVR background recording off
tweaks.why: Xbox background capture re-encodes gameplay continuously - measurable FPS cost for a feature most never use. Game Bar overlay itself still works.

tweaks.name: Memory Integrity (HVCI) off [SECURITY TRADEOFF]
tweaks.why: Biggest single FPS item: 5-15% in CPU-bound games. BUT it is a real security feature blocking malicious kernel drivers. Reasonable on a pure gaming rig; keep it on if unsure.
